summary: CJ added Channel3 so advertisers can send product info to AI shopping apps, and its CEO talked up 'connected commerce'.
Walmart's creator lead DJ Vaughn made Ad Age's media buying power list for growing Walmart's creator programme.
Other partner posts (impact.com, Partnerize, Kobo, retailer LinkedIn) were routine and left out.

items.title: CJ Adds Channel3 to Connect Advertisers With AI Shopping Apps
items.why: Affiliate networks are building pipes into AI shopping apps. Commission is starting to follow AI recommendations, not only human-shared links.

items.title: The Santi Pierini Interview
items.why: CJ's CEO on AI and connected commerce: networks see search, social, creators and affiliate merging.

items.title: DJ Vaughn is elevating creators and entrepreneurs at Walmart
items.why: Walmart keeps investing in creators and entrepreneurs, a sign its creator programme is a serious alternative to Amazon's.
